Dark navy theme renders cleanly, NO red screen, only expected non-critical Expo web warnings (useNativeDriver fallback, props.pointerEvents deprecation — benign). action_items: (Non-blocking, polish) factura/[id].tsx displays Baza/TVA formatted via formatRON which rounds to whole RON for display (680 -> 'Baza 571 RON / TVA 109 RON'). The underlying invoice doc has exact net/vat (e.g. 571.43/108.57) and backend summary + vat_month uses the exact values — only cosmetic rounding on screen. If invoice legal document fidelity is required, format Baza/TVA with 2 decimals in factura/[id].tsx lines 78-79 (currently formatRON(data.net)/formatRON(data.vat)).

(Nit) create_invoice stamps invoice.status based on the ORDER's paid amount at generation time (so an unpaid finalized order with paid=0 produces 'Emisa'; a paid-in-full order produces 'Platita'). This means the invoice does not require the order to be in Finalizat status — any non-deleted order works. If product intent is 'only Finalizat orders can be invoiced', add a status guard in POST /api/invoices (server.py line 1196-1201).
(Observation only, no change needed) /facturi screen uses invoice-row-{id} testID — pattern matches review request.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1140-1144 next_invoice_no uses find_one_and_update with $inc + upsert + ReturnDocument.AFTER — correctly produces strictly increasing per-org per-series numbers; verified by test_create_invoice_from_order_split_19 producing NODE-0001.

server.py line 1155-1158 _vat_split rounds net via round(gross/(1+rate/100),2) and derives vat = gross - net, guaranteeing net+vat == gross even after rounding — correct Romanian GROSS-to-NET convention.

server.py line 1199-1201 duplicate guard scopes on {order_id, organization_id, deleted_at:None} — soft-deleted invoice allows re-invoicing the same order; test_duplicate_invoice_409 and test_parent_can_delete_invoice both green.
server.py line 1225 invoice stores a SNAPSHOT of org.company dict at creation time — client sees frozen fiscal data even if company fields change later. Correct for legal docs.
server.py line 1245 payment amount clamped via min(body.amount, remaining) — prevents overpayment, verified.
server.py line 1256 DELETE is a soft delete (sets deleted_at); scoped by organization_id. Parent-only via require_parent dependency — partner gets 403.
server.py now 1373 lines — same recommendation as iter4/5/6: split into routers (auth, products, collaborators, orders, dashboard, invoicing).

frontend factura/[id].tsx line 109 uses regex v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g,'') for pay-amount-input — allows multiple decimal dots (e.g. '1.2.3'). Minor; parseFloat still works but user could type invalid chars. Low priority.
frontend setari-firma.tsx wires PUT /api/company via useMutation — form fields all have testIDs matching spec; good.
frontend (tabs)/index.tsx line 118-131 renders dash-billing only when billQ.data is truthy; silently absent when query errors — consider skeleton/loader for first load. Minor.

All text wrapped in <Text>, no raw strings, StyleSheet via makeStyles, no HTML tags detected. No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) in the Phase-3 code paths.
